events.verdict: Williams (CHA) firms up over his right foot in Gordon's (DEN) path when marginal contact occurs to his side as the screen is set.
After the pick, Green (CHA) attempts to roll toward the basket when Gordon (DEN) wraps his arms around Green, which affects his FOM off-ball.
Murray (DEN) moves alongside Bridges' (CHA) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) aligns alongside Bridges' (CHA) path when marginal contact occurs as he slides his hand off Bridges during the driving shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before shooting.
Williams (CHA) jumps forward as he contests and initiates illegal body contact with Jokic (DEN) during his upward shooting motion.
Jokic (DEN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.

Replay review of the foul called on Green (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although Green (CHA) initially makes contact with the ball, he then pulls Jokic's (DEN) hand off it while making further contact with Jokic's right arm.
Gordon (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves alongside Bridges' (CHA) path when incidental body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Green (CHA) grasps and immediately releases Murray's (DEN) jersey causing marginal contact to occur after Murray gathers.
Murray (DEN) avoids making any arm contact with Smith Jr. (CHA) as he loses control of the ball during his upwards shooting motion.
Smith Jr. (CHA) takes a dribble and fumbles the ball naturally during his upward shooting motion. He is allowed to be the first to touch as long as he does not dribble again, which he does here.
Murray (DEN) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Smith Jr.'s (CHA) arm.
Williams (CHA) does not release the ball prior to the expiration of the game clock.
